meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: 把项目在 claude-mem 的完整时间线按 ISO 周拆成分段文件，再按顺序为每周运行一个子代理，后一周接收前一周遗留的结转块，逐周写一章，最终合成一份连续的多章周回顾。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成“weekly digests”“week-by-week story”“serial timeline”等按周连续的项目回顾，或说“逐周继续这个故事”时触发。

say.text: 把 [项目名] 的历史按周写成连续的多章回顾。
say.note: 时间线会先被按周切开，再逐章产出。

say.text: 生成 [项目名] 从第一周到最近一周的 weekly digests。
say.note: 章节数等于有数据的总周数。

say.text: 为 [项目名] 做逐周叙事摘要，每周一章讲完整个故事。
say.note: 最后一章会写“现在在哪里”，不给故事硬收尾。

howto.what_en: Splits a project’s full claude-mem timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one subagent per week in order. Each later subagent gets the prior week’s carry-forward block, and one narrative chapter is written per ISO week — a serial digest.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks for weekly digests, week-by-week story, or serial timeline for a project’s history.

say_en.text: Write [project]’s history as a chapter-per-week serial recap.
say_en.note: Timeline is split by week before chapters are written.

say_en.text: Generate weekly digests for [project] from the first week to the latest.
say_en.note: Chapter count equals the number of weeks with data.

say_en.text: Produce a serial weekly digest for [project] covering the whole timeline.
say_en.note: Final chapter uses “Where We Are” instead of an ending.
